Change c0043. Location: 1818 Letter IV; 1831 Letter IV.

Context before (unchanged): Yesterday the stranger said to me, "You may easily perceive, Captain Walton, that I have suffered great and unparalleled misfortunes.

1818 text: I had determined, once, that the memory of these evils should die with me; but you have won me to alter my determination.

1831 text: I had determined, at one time, that the memory of these evils should die with me; but you have won me to alter my determination.

Diff: I had determined, [-once-] {+at one time+} , that the memory of these evils should die with me; but you have won me to alter my determination.

Context after (unchanged): You seek for knowledge and wisdom, as I once did; and I ardently hope that the gratification of your wishes may not be a serpent to sting you, as mine has been.

result.rationale: Replaces the single adverb "once" with the phrase "at one time"; same meaning (formerly, previously), only diction and rhythm change, with no alteration of events or moral content.
